packageRules.description: Rector bundles its own phpdoc-parser and must match PHPStan's, so the two always update together (Booster 1.8.1 shipped Rector 2.8.1 with PHPStan 2.3.4 and Rector died on every closure).

tools/a11y mirrors Preflight's pinned checker (axe-core, @axe-core/playwright, Playwright image); a Preflight release moves them together, so Renovate leaves the folder alone (tripped main on 2026-11-24).
